shapewright.modedescription.normal: Disable mod and use vanilla placement rules
shapewright.modedescription.normal_plus: Like vanilla, but with increased reach
shapewright.modedescription.dome: Build a domed roof. Click center, set radius, then height.
shapewright.action.open_server_config.de: Change reach, placement limits and what blocks you can break here.
shapewright.action.preview_lock.descript: Anchor the current preview in the world. Walk around to check it, right-click to build it, left-click or lock again to release it.
shapewright.message.preview_locked: §aPreview anchored » Ctrl+scroll picks a tool, Shift+scroll moves it, right-click builds
shapewright.action.replace_only_air.desc: You can only place blocks where there was air. Replaceables such as short grass and ferns can still be replaced.
shapewright.action.replace_blocks_and_ai: You can replace blocks and air.
shapewright.action.replace_only_blocks.d: You can only replace blocks, not air.
shapewright.action.replace_filtered_by_o: You can only replace blocks that match the block in your offhand.
shapewright.action.toggle_protect_tile_e: If enabled, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers can not be replaced.
shapewright.message.only_break_placed: You can only break blocks that you placed this session
shapewright.message.only_replace_placed: You can only replace blocks that you placed this session
shapewright.message.breaking_disabled: Breaking blocks with build modes is disabled in survival
shapewright.message.too_hard: Some blocks exceeded the maximum hardness
shapewright.message.world_border: Some blocks are outside the world border or build height
shapewright.message.not_operator: Only admins can edit functional settings.
shapewright.message.welcome_message: Thank you for using Shapewright! To get started, hold %s to open the build menu.
shapewright.message.build_mode_hint: You have activated a build mode! With a block in hand, right-click to pick the starting position. Aim somewhere else, then right-click again to build the shape. To deactivate, hold %s and select Disable.
shapewright.config.reach.tooltip: How far away you can place and break blocks with build modes.
shapewright.config.max_blocks_placed.too: Maximum number of blocks placed in a single action.
shapewright.config.max_blocks_per_axis.t: Maximum size of a build mode shape along any axis.
shapewright.config.max_mirror_size.toolt: Maximum diameter for mirror and radial mirror modifiers.
shapewright.config.max_array_count.toolt: Maximum number of copies an array modifier can produce.
shapewright.config.max_array_offset.tool: Maximum offset distance for each array modifier axis.
shapewright.config.allow_breaking.toolti: If on, build modes can be used to break blocks.
shapewright.config.only_placed_blocks.to: If on, you can only break blocks that were placed this session.
shapewright.config.max_hardness.tooltip:
Maximum block hardness that can be broken. -1 = no limit.

Examples:
  0.5 = Dirt, Sand
  1.5 = Stone
  2.0 = Wood Planks, Logs
  4.5 = Ores
  50 = Obsidian
shapewright.config.require_tools.tooltip: If on, you must have the correct tools in your inventory to break blocks.
shapewright.config.use_durability.toolti: If on, breaking blocks will consume durability from the appropriate tool in your inventory.
If on, each player receives the welcome message once per world.
If on, each player receives the build-mode usage hint once per world.
shapewright.config.preview_block_size.to: Size of block previews as a percentage of a full block.
shapewright.config.preview_block_transpa: Transparency of block previews. 0% = invisible, 100% = solid.
shapewright.config.max_block_previews.to:
Maximum number of block models rendered in the preview.
Lower values improve performance with large shapes.
Outlines are always drawn for all blocks.
shapewright.config.protect_tile_entities: If on, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers cannot be replaced or broken.
shapewright.modedescription.shape: Build the shape from the Shape Generator. Click to place it, or click the center and then the edge to size it.
Design gears, rings, arches, stars and more, or load a schematic.
shapewright.action.shape_size_screen.des: One click places the shape at the size set in the Shape Generator.
shapewright.action.shape_size_clicks.des: Click the center, then click at the edge. The design scales to that radius.
shapewright.message.no_shape_templates: No shape templates yet. Save one in the Shape Generator.
shapewright.screen.use_shape.description: Switch to Shape mode with this shape.
shapewright.screen.schematic.description: Put .schem files (WorldEdit) or .nbt files (structure blocks) in config/shapewright/schematics, schematics, or config/worldedit/schematics. Your held block is placed wherever the file has a block. In multiplayer the server needs the file too.
shapewright.screen.editing.description: Click to switch between the main shape and its parts. Parts combine with everything before them, in order.
shapewright.screen.add_part: Add another shape. It joins on; change its Operation to cut, intersect or exclude instead.
shapewright.screen.view.description: 3D, or a slice through the top, front or side
shapewright.screen.drag_to_rotate: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom
shapewright.action.open_palette.descript: Build with several blocks at once: from hotbar slots or picked by color. Lit up when on.
shapewright.screen.palette_button.descri: Build with several blocks mixed in a pattern. The 3D preview shows the colors.
shapewright.screen.palette_enabled: Use palette for every build mode
shapewright.screen.palette_source.descri: Hotbar: the blocks in the slots you pick, whatever they hold at build time. Picked: a fixed list chosen here.
shapewright.screen.palette_custom_hint: Click blocks on the right to add
shapewright.screen.palette_pattern.descr: How the blocks are laid out over the build.
shapewright.screen.palette_preview: 3D preview: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom
shapewright.screen.palette_scene.descrip: Switch the preview between a small test room and the shape picked in the Shape Generator, built with this palette.
shapewright.screen.palette_empty: No blocks: pick hotbar slots holding blocks
shapewright.screen.palette_off_hint: Palette is off: builds use your held block
shapewright.screen.palette_rescan.descri: Read every block's color again, e.g. after changing resource packs.
shapewright.screen.palette_all_blocks: All blocks by color (click to add)
shapewright.screen.suggest.shades.descri: Dark to light blocks in the same color family as the first block.
shapewright.screen.suggest.similar.descr: The blocks closest in color to the first block.
shapewright.screen.suggest.blend.descrip: Even steps from the first block to the last one.
shapewright.screen.suggest.analogous.des: The first block plus blocks of nearby hues on the color wheel.
shapewright.screen.suggest.hint: Suggestions start from your palette's first block (or the held block)
shapewright.screen.suggest.need_seed: Add a block or hold one first
shapewright.screen.suggest.neighbors.des: The first block plus blocks of nearby hues on the color wheel.
shapewright.screen.suggest.complement.de: The first block's color and its opposite on the color wheel, in lighter and darker versions.
shapewright.screen.suggest.triad.descrip: Three colors evenly spaced around the color wheel, starting from the first block.
shapewright.screen.suggest.contrast.desc: The first block's hue from near-black to near-white.
shapewright.screen.suggest.surprise.desc: A random colorful block with a random strategy. Reroll for another.
shapewright.screen.palette_reroll.descri: Run the last suggestion again with different picks among the closest matches.
shapewright.screen.palette_save_favorite: Keep this palette in Favorites. A hotbar palette is saved as the blocks it holds now.
shapewright.screen.palette_reload_preset: Read the preset files again. Add your own .json palettes to config/shapewright/palettes.
shapewright.screen.palette_no_favorites: No favorites yet. Use "Save as favorite" on the left.
shapewright.shape.param.deform_axis.desc: The axis twist, taper, shear, wave and bend run along. Depth is the shape's own depth (up for flat shapes).
shapewright.shape.param.twist.descriptio: Like Blender's twist: the first layer stays put and each layer after it turns a bit more, up to this many degrees at the far end. Negative twists the other way.
shapewright.shape.param.taper.descriptio: Scales the cross-section along the axis: 1 shrinks to a point at the far end, negative flares out.
shapewright.shape.param.shear.descriptio: Slides the far end sideways by this many blocks, layer by layer.
shapewright.shape.param.bend_angle.descr: Curves the shape's length into an arc of this many degrees. Negative curves the other way.
shapewright.shape.param.wave.description: Ripples the shape sideways like a sine wave, this many blocks high.
shapewright.shape.param.wave_length.desc: Blocks along the axis for one full wave.
shapewright.shape.param.grow.description: Fattens the shape by this many blocks, or erodes it when negative.
shapewright.shape.param.noise.descriptio: Shifts every block randomly up to this many blocks for a rough, rocky surface.
shapewright.shape.param.decimate.descrip: Removes this percent of the blocks at random, for a crumbled look.
shapewright.shape.param.seed.description: Changes the pattern of noise and decimate.
shapewright.shape.param.center_block.des: Adds a center axle through the shape in a block you pick, even where the shape is open. It is 1 block wide, or 2 by 2 when the shape has an even width and no single middle.
shapewright.screen.picker_hint: Click a block to pick it. Scroll to browse; hold Alt to scroll faster.
shapewright.message.out_of_super_glue: Out of Super Glue: part of the shape was not glued
shapewright.screen.materials.description: What this build needs, what you carry, what your AE2 network holds, and what is missing.
shapewright.screen.export_schem.descript: Save exactly what would be built as a WorldEdit/Litematica .schem in config/shapewright/schematics (named after the template name box).
shapewright.screen.export_nbt.descriptio: Save exactly what would be built as a structure .nbt (structure blocks, Create's schematicannon) in config/shapewright/schematics.
shapewright.message.export_hold_block: Hold a block (or turn on a palette) to export this shape
shapewright.screen.pixel_art.description: Turn a PNG into a schematic made of the blocks whose colors match best.
shapewright.screen.pixel_art_file.descri: Click to pick the next PNG in the images folder.
shapewright.screen.pixel_art_hint: Put .png files in %s. Transparent pixels stay empty.
shapewright.screen.pixel_art_no_blocks: No blocks to use: carry some blocks, or wait for the color scan
shapewright.screen.pixel_art_create.desc: Save it as <image>_art.schem and select it as the shape to build.
shapewright.screen.path_sizing_hint: Click the start, then each point the path goes through. Sneak-click (or click the last point again) to finish
shapewright.action.open_anchor_view.desc: See the whole anchored preview with the terrain around it, move it, build it or release it.
shapewright.screen.anchor_move.descripti: Move the anchored preview one block (five with Shift).
shapewright.screen.anchor_terrain_too_bi: Too big to show the terrain as well
shapewright.screen.anchor_none: Nothing is anchored. Lock a preview first (the anchor button in the radial menu).
shapewright.config.blocks_per_tick.toolt: Big builds are placed this many blocks per server tick, over several ticks, so the server does not freeze. 0 places everything at once.
shapewright.screen.copy_code.description: Copy this design (parts and settings included) as a text code you can paste in chat or Discord.
shapewright.screen.copy_palette_code.des: Copy this palette as a text code you can paste in chat or Discord.
shapewright.screen.paste_code.descriptio: Load a code someone shared (copy it first).
shapewright.message.code_invalid: The clipboard has no code for this
shapewright.shape.param.bearing.descript: Puts a Create mechanical bearing at one end of the center axle, facing the shape and left out of the glue, so the shape can turn. Start = below / north / west, End = above / south / east. Fills the axle if the middle is open.
shapewright.action.open_undo_history.des: See your recent builds and undo or redo several at once.
shapewright.screen.undo_history.hint: Click a build to undo it and everything after it. Grey ones are undone: click to redo.
shapewright.screen.undo_history.empty: Nothing to undo or redo yet
shapewright.shape.param.smooth.descripti: Top blocks one step above their neighbor become stairs (slabs at corners) or slabs of the same block, so slopes look smooth. Blocks with no stairs or slab version stay full. In survival you need the stairs and slabs. Framed slopes needs Framed Blocks: the top becomes framed slopes (framed slabs at corners) camouflaged as the block they replace, and costs one of each plus the block.
shapewright.message.schematic_too_big: Schematic %s is too big to send to this server; put it in the server's schematics folder instead
shapewright.shape.param.align.descriptio: Where the parts stand when their heights differ: from the bottom up, grown both ways from the middle, or hanging from the top. The start values move each part further.
shapewright.shape.param.follow_ground.de: Off: the shape stays level. On: every column moves up or down to sit on the terrain below it.
shapewright.shape.param.super_glue.descr: Glue the built shape with Create super glue, only around its own blocks. In survival it uses your Super Glue's durability.
shapewright.screen.gizmo.description: Shows the red, green and blue axis arrows at the spot the shape is placed at, and a yellow cross at a modifier's origin. Applies to this preview and to the shape in the world.
shapewright.shape.param.deform_origin.de: The layer along the deform axis that stays put while the others twist, taper, shear, wave and bend around it. The origin shows as a yellow marker in the preview.
shapewright.shape.param.origin_x.descrip: Moves the origin this many blocks east (negative: west). Across the deform axis this is the point twist turns around and taper shrinks toward.
shapewright.shape.param.origin_y.descrip: Moves the origin this many blocks up (negative: down).
shapewright.shape.param.origin_z.descrip: Moves the origin this many blocks south (negative: north).
shapewright.screen.part_block.descriptio: The block this part is built with. None: the held block or palette, like the main shape.
shapewright.screen.part_camo.description: Framed Blocks only: the block this part's framed blocks get as camo. Each one costs one of that block in survival. None: no camo.
shapewright.screen.part_repeat.descripti: Copies of this part spread evenly around the main shape (spokes, pillars, towers on a wall). Move the part off-center with the offsets first.
shapewright.screen.drag_part_3d: Shift+drag: move the blue part · Ctrl+drag: up/down · drag: turn
shapewright.screen.drag_part_slice: Drag to move the blue part
shapewright.shape.param.text.description: The words to build. Use | to start a new line. Letters, digits and common punctuation.
shapewright.shape.param.scale.descriptio: Blocks per font pixel: 1 makes letters 7 blocks tall, 2 makes them 14.
shapewright.shape.param.blend_margin.des: How far from the build, in blocks, the ground is raised or cut away to meet it.
shapewright.shape.param.blend_terrain.de: Smooths the ground around the schematic so it sits in the landscape instead of floating above or sinking into it.
shapewright.shape.param.schematic_blocks: Held: build with the block in your hand or the palette. Saved: build with the blocks stored in the schematic.
shapewright.shape.param.pattern.descript: Which blocks of the floor stay. For two blocks, add the same floor as a part with Invert on and its own block.
shapewright.shape.param.teeth.descriptio: Number of teeth around the gear.
shapewright.shape.param.tooth_length.des: How far each tooth sticks out past the gear body.
shapewright.shape.param.tooth_width.desc: Width of each tooth in blocks.
shapewright.shape.param.tooth_rotation.d: Turns the ring of teeth, as a fraction of the gap between two teeth.
shapewright.shape.param.rim_width.descri: Thickness of the gear body ring when the gear is hollow.
shapewright.shape.param.frame_size.descr: Half-width of the square frame inside the gear. 0 for none.
shapewright.shape.param.inner_size.descr: Half-width of the inner square ring. 0 for none.
shapewright.shape.param.inner_width.desc: Thickness of the inner square ring.
shapewright.shape.param.hub_size.descrip: Half-width of the square hub in the middle. 0 for none.
shapewright.shape.param.body_start.descr: Moves the gear body up (or down, if negative) from where its alignment puts it.
shapewright.shape.param.frame_start.desc: Moves the frame up or down.
shapewright.shape.param.inner_height.des: Height of the inner square ring.
shapewright.shape.param.inner_start.desc: Moves the inner ring up or down.
shapewright.shape.param.hub_start.descri: Moves the hub up or down.
shapewright.shape.param.tooth_start.desc: Moves the teeth up or down.
shapewright.shape.param.tube_radius.desc: Radius of the tube the ring is made of.
shapewright.shape.param.height_ratio.des: Height compared with the width. 1 is as tall as it is wide; a pointed arch comes out about 1.7 times taller.
shapewright.shape.param.thickness.descri: How many blocks thick the shape is.
shapewright.shape.param.depth.descriptio: How far the shape reaches through its face, in blocks.
shapewright.shape.param.pole_radius.desc: Radius of the pole in the middle. 0 for none.
shapewright.shape.param.height.descripti: Height of the shape in blocks.
shapewright.shape.param.turns.descriptio: How many times it winds around.
shapewright.shape.param.sides.descriptio: Number of sides. 0 makes it round where that is possible.
shapewright.shape.param.rotation.descrip: Turns the outline, as a fraction of one side.
shapewright.shape.param.points.descripti: Number of points on the star.
shapewright.shape.param.inner_ratio.desc: How deep the star is cut in between points. Low is spiky, high is nearly round.
shapewright.shape.param.battlement.descr: Height of the battlements on top. 0 for a plain top.
shapewright.shape.param.bold.description: Makes every stroke one block wider.
shapewright.shape.param.invert.descripti: Keeps the blocks the pattern leaves out, and leaves out the ones it keeps. Use it with a second floor part for the other half.
shapewright.shape.param.path_spacing.des: Blocks between copies along the path.
shapewright.shape.param.path_align.descr: Turn each copy to face along the path.
shapewright.shape.param.rotate_x.descrip: Turns the shape around the east-west axis, in degrees.
shapewright.shape.param.rotate_y.descrip: Turns the shape around the vertical axis, in degrees.
shapewright.shape.param.rotate_z.descrip: Turns the shape around the north-south axis, in degrees.
shapewright.shape.param.style.descriptio: Round is a half ellipse. Pointed is a gothic arch made of two arcs meeting at a point.
shapewright.shape.param.caps.description: For a hollow shape: leave the top and bottom open, or close them with a floor and a ceiling.
shapewright.shape.param.door.description: Cuts a doorway in the wall on the north side.
shapewright.shape.param.windows.descript: Windows spread evenly around the wall, halfway up. Needs a tower at least 6 high.
shapewright.shape.param.floors.descripti: Floors inside the tower, spread evenly over its height.
shapewright.shape.param.roof.description: Cone: a pointed roof on top that overhangs the wall. Replaces the battlements.
shapewright.shape.param.flip.description: Up stands on its flat side. Down hangs from it, like a bowl.
shapewright.shape.param.steps.descriptio: Number of steps in the whole staircase.
shapewright.shape.param.rise.description: How many blocks each step goes up.
shapewright.shape.param.run.description: How many blocks each step goes forward.
shapewright.shape.param.turn.description: Straight, or a landing halfway where the stairs turn left, right or back on themselves.
shapewright.shape.param.fill.description: Solid fills each step down to the ground. Steps only builds one block per step.
shapewright.shape.param.pipe_length.desc: Length of the first straight part of the pipe.
shapewright.shape.param.bend.description: Straight, or an elbow that turns the pipe a quarter turn toward the east.
shapewright.shape.param.bend_radius.desc: How wide the elbow curves. At least the pipe radius plus one.
shapewright.shape.param.pipe_arm.descrip: Length of the straight part after the elbow.
shapewright.shape.param.length.descripti: Half the floor's length: the floor is 2 × length + 1 blocks long. Radius sets the width the same way.
shapewright.shape.param.tile.description: Blocks per tile, stripe, border width or ring.
shapewright.screen.save_template.descrip: Save this design as a template under the name on the left (Ctrl+S, or Enter in the name box).
shapewright.shape.param.anchor.descripti: Which point of the shape sits on the spot you place it at. Base center is the default: the shape stands on that spot. Center, top center and lowest corner put the shape around, below or beside it.
shapewright.shape.param.anchor_x.descrip: Moves the anchor point this many blocks east (negative: west) of the chosen anchor. The shape moves the other way, so the anchor still lands on the spot you place it at.
shapewright.shape.param.anchor_y.descrip: Moves the anchor point this many blocks up (negative: down). Use it to sink a shape into the ground or lift it.
shapewright.shape.param.anchor_z.descrip: Moves the anchor point this many blocks south (negative: north).
shapewright.screen.ghost_import.descript: Use a ghost build from the mc-mcp mod as this shape's source, then twist, taper or bend it like any schematic.
shapewright.message.ghost_sent: Sent "%s" to mc-mcp as a ghost at your feet.
shapewright.screen.reload_schematics.des: Rescan the schematic folders (config/shapewright/schematics, schematics, config/worldedit/schematics) for files added while the game runs, e.g. exported from a ghost build.
